change: On 2 Nov 2026 Advent International signed an agreement to acquire VERMEG from Charterhouse Capital Partners and founder Badreddine Ouali; an ADIA subsidiary joins as minority co-investor; price undisclosed; completion expected H1 2027 subject to regulatory approvals. On completion Ouali becomes Vice Chairman (remains shareholder) and Advent Operating Partner Mike Ettling becomes Chairman. Status: pending acquisition.
Add person: Nizar Chaddad, Director General (CEO), succeeding Bilel Dernaoui; reported 2 Nov 2026 from his LinkedIn announcement; previously 27 years at the BCT. Exact effective date not stated.

Reported 15-16 Oct 2026.
